instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. 3 of 5 tests fail and the file fails yarn test:typecheck. Fix the test only (the source behaves correctly; verified). (1) TS2305 at line 5: `Module '"@excalidraw/element"' has no exported member 'createFlowchart'.` The real API is `addNewNodes(startNode, appState, direction, scene, numberOfNodes)` from packages/element/src/flowchart.ts:272, exported from @excalidraw/element, returning `{ nodes, crossStart }` where nodes is [nextNode, bindingArrow, ...]. Use `const { nodes } = addNewNodes(rect, h.state, "right", h.app.scene, 1); const bindingArrow = nodes.find((n) => n.type === "arrow") as ExcalidrawArrowElement;` (put rect into the scene with API.setElements([rect]) first). (2) TS2554 at line 228: `Expected 4-5 arguments, but got 2.` convertToShape's signature (packages/element/src/convertToShape.ts:535) is `convertToShape(points: GlobalPoint[], appState: AppState, elementsMap: ElementsMap, previousElement: ExcalidrawElement | null, frames?)`. Pass the arrow gesture as GlobalPoint[] (pointFrom<GlobalPoint>(x, y), import type GlobalPoint from @excalidraw/math), `h.state`, `h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElementsMap()`, `null`; drop the freedraw element. (3) TS2769 at lines 324 and 328: exportScene's `data` needs `appState` and `files`; call it as in packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/export.test.ts:71-79: `exportScene({ type: "svg", data: { elements, appState: { viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff" }, files: {} }, config: { canvasBackgroundColor: false } })`. (4) `restores the previous arrowheadSize after a single Keyboard.undo()` -> `expected 1.25 to be 0.5` at line 127: Keyboard.undo() fires keydown on document, which reaches the editor only when it is rendered with `handleKeyboardGlobally={true}` (as every test in history.test.tsx does). Render `<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />` in every test of this file. (5) `propagates currentItemArrowheadSize ...` -> `expected 1 to be 0.5` at line 185: wrap each direct `h.app.actionManager.executeAction(...)` call (lines 180, 271, 274) in `act(() => { ... })`, importing `act` from "./test-utils" (it re-exports @testing-library/react). (6) `restores an arrow with arrowheadSize 0.5 and exports a smaller SVG head path` -> `expected 11.75 to be close to 11.745000000000005, received difference is 0.005, but expected 0.0005` at line 341: SVG coordinates are rounded to 2 decimals; use precision 1 in the spanX/spanY toBeCloseTo checks. Keep all five tests and their intent; keep the testIds arrowheadSize-small/-medium/-large/-veryLarge.
